Frequently Asked Questions

Is Dow University better than Hamdard?

Both Dow University of Health Sciences and Hamdard University are HEC-recognized universities. Dow University is public (est. 2004) in Karachi, while Hamdard is private (est. 1991) in Karachi. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between Dow University and Hamdard?

Dow University's fee is approximately Rs. 40–80K/sem per semester, while Hamdard's is Rs. 80–150K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for Dow University and Hamdard?

Dow University: MDCAT required, 70%+. Hamdard: 65%+ in FSc.
